name: SHA-256 FIPS 180-4 byte-domain specification
domain: Whole-byte messages with bit length strictly below 2^64.
input_semantics: Bytes encoded into SHA-256 words in big-endian order. Streaming updates concatenate in delivery order.
output_semantics: A 32-byte big-endian digest. An overflowing update preserves the prior state.
preconditions: The sum of accepted byte lengths is at most 2^61 - 1.
